dict.string: Peripheral Glow Track 8: Aggressive FM fuzz guitar. Sawtooth carrier, square modulator, high FM amount. Use with Distortion (drive 35%, tone 50%) or Pedalboard Fuzz Machine, Channel EQ (-2dB@200Hz, +4dB@1.5kHz, -3dB@4kHz), ChromaVerb (1.2s, 20% wet).
ONLY plays bars 59-74 (Extended Instrumental). Power chords D4-Bb4. Single-note melody bars 67-70: Bb-A/G-A/Bb-G/F/D. Velocity ramps 55 to 80 over 16 bars.
